title: Kirby Problem 3.15
exact_target: Which real cohomology classes occur as Euler classes of taut foliations, tight or universally tight contact structures, pseudo-Anosov or quasigeodesic flows, and oriented circle actions on a closed hyperbolic three-manifold with positive first Betti number?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2813 (KP-3.15). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.15, p. 141 and following remarks; original author version.
